name: continuity-ops
description: Single-organization incident command and service recovery workspace for operations teams.

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrations:list:local: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:local && cross-env WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log vinext dev
scripts.test:unit: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/operations-domain.test.ts tests/operations-authorization.test.ts tests/operations-time.test.ts tests/service-lifecycle-cursor.test.ts tests/operations-input.test.ts tests/operations-bootstrap.test.mjs tests/observability-client.test.ts tests/observability-role-focus.test.ts tests/observability-demo-data.test.mjs tests/public-site-url.test.ts tests/sign-in-qr.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit:coverage: node --experimental-strip-types --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=90 --test-coverage-branches=80 --test-coverage-functions=80 --test tests/operations-domain.test.ts tests/operations-authorization.test.ts tests/operations-time.test.ts tests/service-lifecycle-cursor.test.ts tests/operations-input.test.ts tests/operations-bootstrap.test.mjs tests/observability-client.test.ts tests/observability-role-focus.test.ts tests/observability-demo-data.test.mjs tests/public-site-url.test.ts tests/sign-in-qr.test.mjs
scripts.test:migration:wrangler: cross-env CI=true WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/test-migration-state
scripts.test:migration: npm run test:migration:sql && npm run test:migration:wrangler
scripts.gate:static: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.gate:supply-chain: npm run test:security:supply-chain && npm run security:secrets && npm run sbom:generate
scripts.gate:test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:gherkin && npm run test:gherkin:fault-injection && npm run test:migration && npm run test:tools && npm run test:fault-injection && npm run test:quality
scripts.gate:build: npm run build && npm run test:integration && npm run test:runtime-bootstrap:local && npm run evidence:manifest
scripts.gate:ci: npm run gate:supply-chain && npm run gate:static && npm run gate:test && npm run gate:build
